title: Early-User Production Stabilization

runtime.architecture: Windows/network -> WSL2 -> FastAPI -> Typesense PRIMARY; Postgres infrastructure-only degraded fallback
runtime.typesense_service: systemd user service bidfinder-typesense.service using local-typesense.sh foreground mode
runtime.fastapi_service: systemd user service bidfinder-api.service, uvicorn one worker
runtime.graceful_stop: SIGTERM with SendSIGKILL=no; Typesense stop timeout 300 seconds

second_run.reason: no fully closed dates are missing

scheduler.overlap_lock: flock held on serving-maintenance.lock; overlapping invocation exits 0 with 'already running'

snapshot_recovery.validation: Typesense snapshot plus checkpoint/provenance/report copied to unique staging; SQLite integrity and generation checks passed; bundle status VALIDATED
snapshot_recovery.restore_policy: restore validates bundle and generation, quarantines live data recoverably, then starts the validated copy; no live restore was performed against the 10M-document corpus

resource_guards.interpretation: short query CPU spikes are normal; no sustained saturation, OOM, or swap-growth signal observed

logs.retention: daily user-journal vacuum at 03:30, 14 days and 250M bounds

network_security.secret_storage: external mode-600 WSL environment files; no credentials in service definitions or Git
network_security.external_ingress: not configured; a secured FastAPI reverse proxy/tunnel is required for users outside this machine

http_smoke.runtime: actual HTTP through a persistent systemd-managed uvicorn process on loopback
http_smoke.full_access_test_process: temporary loopback-only port 8002 with environment-only anonymous-full access; stopped after test

fallback.test: isolated FastAPI process with unavailable Typesense port and 60-second test-only legacy SQL budget

validation.full_root_pytest: not used as gate; repository root has unrelated raw-data I/O and Selenium collection errors documented during audit

known_limitations: Postgres fallback is a legacy subset, not the complete 10M-document corpus.
Broad quantity sorting is approximately 1.0 seconds p50 on this machine.
The serving generation is explicit; aliases are not active.
Availability depends on Windows power, sleep, updates, network, and WSL lifecycle.
This is single-machine local hosting, not HA hosting.
FastAPI external ingress is intentionally not configured; do not expose Typesense directly.
recommendation: PASS for local single-machine early-user operation with the runbook. Do not open it to users outside this machine until a secured FastAPI-only ingress is added; no continuous Codex session is required once WSL is running.
